output.reason: The brief offers a specific mechanism (CR-118 changed the premium start time while being logged as a label fix), backs it with the audit trail and a reproduction in the test system, and fits the pattern in the tickets: only the night premium was short and the hours were correct. The 147-underpaid vs 139-complainant figures only roughly reconcile (147 − 8 = 139 assumes all complaints came from these 158 workers) and rest on evidence I haven't seen, but each action it recommends is clear.
